reasons.plausibility: Adding a small amount of silver to enhance mechanical toughness without severely disrupting magnetic properties is scientifically credible, as similar doping strategies have been used in related alloy systems.
reasons.testability: A controlled experiment comparing the doped and undoped alloys using well-defined mechanical and magnetocaloric measurements provides a straightforward route to confirming or refuting the hypothesis.
reasons.usefulness: Researchers seeking to improve mechanical robustness in MnNiSi-based magnetic-refrigeration materials while preserving their magnetocaloric response would find this doping strategy directly applicable.
